---
title: "Function reference"
---

All functions and classes exported by contoso.

## Functions

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`calendar()`](reference/calendar.qmd) | Calendar Dimension Data from the Contoso Dataset |
| [`create_contoso_duckdb()`](reference/create_contoso_duckdb.qmd) | Creates DuckDB database with Contoso datasets |
| [`customer()`](reference/customer.qmd) | Customer Data from the Contoso Dataset |
| [`fx()`](reference/fx.qmd) | Foreign Exchange Data from the Contoso Dataset |
| [`launch_ui()`](reference/launch_ui.qmd) | Launch the DuckDB UI in your browser |
| [`orderrows()`](reference/orderrows.qmd) | Order Rows Data from the Contoso Dataset |
| [`orders()`](reference/orders.qmd) | Order Data from the Contoso Dataset |
| [`product()`](reference/product.qmd) | Product Data from the Contoso Dataset |
| [`sales()`](reference/sales.qmd) | Sales Data from the Contoso Dataset |
| [`store()`](reference/store.qmd) | Store Data from the Contoso Dataset |
